summary: Allocates a buffer through an allocator object vtable. Reads allocation flags from the request struct: the base flag is 2048 (2064 when request flag bit 0 is set), and when request flag bit 0x20 is set the allocation-type hint field at this[0x13E0] selects between flag 0x2000 and 0x1000. The allocator's vtable entry at +44 is called with sizes a4*a2[2] and a5*a2[2] and the computed flags. The result is stored into *this (field 0x0). Returns 0 on success; on failure the request failure counter (a2[5]) is incremented and the buffer ID is returned. Null request struct or null allocator object return 0 early.

operations.description: If the request struct a2 is null, return 0 immediately without allocating.
If the allocator object pointer at a2[8] is null, return 0 immediately.
Initialize the allocation flags to 2048; raise them to 2064 when request flag bit 0 (a2[0] & 1) is set.

When request flag bit 0x20 (a2[0] & 0x20) is set, decode the allocation-type hint field this[0x13E0]: a null or out-of-range hint (<= 0 or > 2) selects flag 0x2000, and a hint in range selects 0x1000 unless the a3 flag bit 0x40 is set, which forces 0x2000.

Indirect stdcall call to the allocator vtable entry at offset +44 of the allocator object (a2[8]), passing the allocator object, sizes a4*a2[2] and a5*a2[2], an out buffer-ID pointer, and the computed flags; returns the allocation pointer.
Store the allocator return value into *this (field 0x0).
Return 0 when the allocation succeeded (non-null result); on failure increment the request failure counter (a2[5]) and return the buffer ID written by the allocator.
